{"subject":"Recap: Apex technical validation on 2026-09-29","body":"Hi Gregor and Tamsin,

Thanks for your time today. Here is what we covered.

Shown on your sample data:
- Column level lineage on the loan book model
- A masking policy on borrower name and national ID, visible to analysts only when masked unless they hold the steward role
- The warehouse connector, which syncs continuously, about a minute end to end

Open items:
- Stored procedures: Tamsin, most of yours are dynamic, so Sofia will see if she can get a couple run through our parser. We have no timing yet. Sofia will also send a short write-up of what she needs from you.
- Data dictionary: Gregor, you will try to find it so we can scope the full model, maybe next week.
- Procurement: Tamsin, you may loop them in early after checking with your manager.

Gregor, you mentioned reconnecting sometime after that, depending on quarter close, and that you would ping me. Is there anything we can send that makes that easier?
